text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I never thought I'd still be able to grow 
veggies even after coming to the Academy~! 
I'm so glad we have a field here...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Watching the veggies grow bigger every day 
and getting lost in working the soil just 
warms me right up inside~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Trainer-san, would you like to 
join in next time?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Apparently it's called "clover healing"! I 
totally recommend it for a "city boy" like 
you, Trainer~!
